label: L=3 first copy step (t=4), plus weak firing on initial c/j/2
explanation: Two disjoint, precise components. (A) Length-3 sequences at step 4, the first copy step after <DEL> (input = original token 0, outputting original token 1): fires on ~75% of such steps and carries all the large activations (~51% of mass, top quartile); the misses there have no obvious token pattern. (B) Step 0 when the first token is c, j or the digit 2: fires on essentially every such step but weakly (~0.02 of max per step; ~49% of mass because it is so frequent). Never fires on the delimiter step, on any other original-phase position, on copy steps other than t=4, or on sequences longer than 3 in the copy phase. Combined predicate: dev F1 0.97, precision 0.95, recall 1.0.
